annotator: ONE LLM annotator. NOT human annotation; no second annotator; no kappa.
protocol: Real RSS headline titles from 35 outlets, fetched 2026-11-15; labels decided from the text alone; picked by the annotator from a random pool, so not a random sample. DEV ONLY: used for retrieval few-shot and tuning; never mixed into data/eval. Stories already in eval_v2 were excluded.
